<p>This 2023 Toyota Tacoma 2WD SR5 offers a robust V6 engine paired with a smooth 6-speed automatic transmission, delivering reliable rear-wheel drive performance. The crew cab with a short bed provides versatility, featuring comfortable bucket seats with driver-adjustable lumbar support and a power driver seat for personalized comfort. The rear bench seat includes a convenient pass-through for added practicality.</p>
<p>Equipped with safety technologies such as front collision mitigation, lane departure warning, driver monitoring, and multiple airbags including knee and side airbags, this Tacoma prioritizes your peace of mind. Stability and traction control, along with brake assist and ABS, enhance control on various road conditions. Tow hooks and a tow hitch expand its capability for hauling needs.</p>
<p>Enjoy modern conveniences like adaptive cruise control, keyless entry and start, an auto-dimming rearview mirror, and Bluetooth connectivity. The back-up camera and fog lamps improve visibility and maneuvering ease. Aluminum wheels with all-season tires complement the rugged exterior, while heated mirrors and privacy glass add functional style. This Tacoma is designed for drivers seeking a dependable, well-equipped small pickup truck.</p>
<p>Be sure to call or visit Toyota of Dallas to discover more. Your new favorite vehicle awaits - don't let someone else drive it home!</p>?

description: 2007 Honda S2000 for sale! Motorcar Classics is proud to present this ultra-low-mileage 2007 Honda S2000, finished in striking Laguna Blue Pearl (B-545P) over a crisp Black leather interior. Showing just 11,228 miles from new, this collector-grade example represents one of the most desirable specifications of Honda's legendary roadster. Originally delivered to Jack Matia Honda in Elyria, Ohio, this vehicle boasts a clean Carfax report with no history of accidents or damage. Equipped with its factory power-operated black soft top with glass rear window, matching tonneau cover, xenons, original 17-inch ten-spoke alloy wheels wrapped in Bridgestone Potenza RE050 tires, and dual polished exhaust outlets, this unmolested S2000 retains all of its factory literature, window sticker ($34,845 original MSRP), three keys, and two remote fobs.As an AP2 generation model, this 2007 iteration benefits from all the refined mechanical updates introduced to mature the platform into the ultimate street-driven sports car. Under the hood lies the famed high-revving 2.2-liter VTEC inline-four (F22C1), factory rated at 237 horsepower and 162 lb-ft of torque. Honda tuned the AP2's engine with a larger displacement to increase low-end and midrange torque, significantly improving everyday drivability over early AP1 cars while retaining a screaming 8,000 RPM redline. Power is routed through what is widely regarded as one of the best manual gearboxes ever builta razor-sharp 6-speed short-throw transmissionand sent to the rear wheels via a Torsen limited-slip differential.Further enhancing the AP2 generation are extensive chassis and suspension refinements, including revised double-wishbone geometry, progressive-valve gas shock absorbers, stiffened subframes, and updated front and rear stabilizer bars designed to make handling more progressive and predictable near the limit. The 2007 model year specifically sits in the ideal "sweet spot" of S2000 production: it includes drive-by-wire throttle and Vehicle Stability Assist (VSA) traction control for added safety and modern precision, yet retains the traditional mechanical steering character before interior styling revisions in later years. The interior offers a driver-focused, cockpit-like layout featuring supportive leather sport bucket seats, aluminum pedals, cold air conditioning, cruise control, digital instrumentation with a sweeping tachometer, and power conveniences throughout. Impeccably preserved and mechanically dialed-in, this 11k-mile Laguna Blue Pearl AP2 is an investment-quality icon ready for the most discerning collector or enthusiast.

Meet the 2019 Ram 1500 Limited 4WDa full-size pickup that somehow manages to be both a serious workhorse and the nicest vehicle in the parking lot, because apparently trucks are allowed to have leather and luxury these days. Under the hood sits the legendary 5.7L HEMI V8, producing an impressive 395 horsepower and 410 lb-ft of torque, paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and 4WD for confident traction and serious capability when the road gets rough. The Limited trim is Rams top-shelf treatment, bringing premium leather-trimmed seating, heated and ventilated front seats, heated rear seats, a heated steering wheel, power-adjustable front seats, dual-zone automatic climate control, remote start, keyless entry, and a large Uconnect touchscreen with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. When its time to put the muscle to work, the 5.7L HEMI delivers the kind of effortless torque that makes hauling and towing feel less like a chore and more like an excuse to buy another trailer. Depending on configuration and equipment, this Ram 1500 can tow up to approximately 12,750 pounds and offers a payload capacity of up to around 2,300 pounds, giving you plenty of muscle for boats, campers, equipment, work trailers, or weekend toys. Add in the spacious crew cab, versatile truck bed, bold exterior styling, premium wheels, and 4WD capability, and you have a pickup that checks nearly every box. Whether you're heading to the jobsite, towing the toys, cruising the highway, or simply making a trip to the hardware store that somehow requires a 395-horsepower V8, this 2019 Ram 1500 Limited is ready to do it in style. Its tough when you need it, luxurious when you want it, and just flashy enough to remind everyone that you didn't come here to drive a boring truck.
